description:
A free price checker and XP tracker for Path of Exile 2.

Point at an item in Path of Exile 2 and press Ctrl+E: a panel next to your inventory shows what similar items sell for on the official trade site, with filters you can adjust. Currency Exchange items are priced from the trades GGG publishes every hour, and unique items also show poe2scout's price. An XP overlay right on the game's HUD shows how fast you level, how long until the next level and how long the current map has run. Works with the English and Russian game clients.
PoE2 Oracle is a fan-made tool: it isn't affiliated with or endorsed by Grinding Gear Games.
